corrections.oldValue: Holy water circle, or burning incense; reverse uses blood or smoldering dung
corrections.newValue: 3′-diameter circle on floor or ground: holy water for protection from evil, blood for protection from good; alternatively, in the air using burning incense or smoldering dung with respect to evil/good.

corrections.oldValue: A 1-foot barrier prevents bodily contact by the enchanted, conjured and summoned creatures described in the source.
corrections.newValue: A ward one foot from the recipient prevents bodily contact by enchanted or conjured beings, including aerial servants, demons, devils, djinn, efreet, elementals, imps, invisible stalkers, night hags, quasits, salamanders, water weirds, wind walkers and xorn; summoned animals or monsters are similarly kept away.
corrections.scope: Only this exact existing mechanics leaf and literal old/new values; no new/unrelated leaf grade or field-to-excerpt target approval.

corrections.oldValue: Ends when concentration stops. If the cleric is behind an opponent, its attacks gain the rear-attack benefits described in the source.
corrections.newValue: The spell ends when the cleric ceases concentrating.
corrections.scope: Only this exact existing mechanics leaf and literal old/new values; no new/unrelated leaf grade or field-to-excerpt target approval.

corrections.oldValue: Retrieval normally gains 4 free surprise rounds; a target able to detect invisibility uses the source’s surprise roll. A successful hit grabs the target, followed by a strength comparison.
corrections.newValue: When sent on a mission, the servant attacks by complete surprise and gains 4 free melee rounds unless the creature involved can detect invisible objects; then roll 1d6: 1 = 1 free round, 2 = 2, 3 = 3, 4 = 4, and 5 or 6 = 0 (the opponent is not surprised). Each round, the servant rolls to hit; a hit means it grabbed the assigned object or creature. If a creature is involved, compare strength; if it has no strength rating, roll the appropriate number and type of hit dice for the servant and creature. The higher total is the stronger.
corrections.scope: Only this exact existing mechanics leaf and literal old/new values; no new/unrelated leaf grade or field-to-excerpt target approval.

corrections.oldValue: Movement, attack frequency, damage, armor class and durability depend on shape, material and mass; the referee decides these values.
corrections.newValue: Movement depends on means of propulsion and weight. Examples: a large stone pedestal rocks forward 1″ per round, a stone statue moves 4″ per round, a wooden statue 8″ per round, and a light ivory stool 12″ per round; slithering is about 1″–2″ per round and rolling 3″–6″ per round.
corrections.scope: Only this exact existing mechanics leaf and literal old/new values; no new/unrelated leaf grade or field-to-excerpt target approval.

corrections.oldValue: Flexible objects can obstruct, trip, bind or smother; harder objects can strike or crush.
corrections.newValue: Light, supple objects can only obscure vision, obstruct movement, bind, trip or smother. Light, hard objects can strike for 1–2 hit points or possibly obstruct and trip as light, supple objects; hard medium-weight objects can crush or strike for 2–8 hit points, and larger/heavier objects for 3–12, 4–16 or 5–20 hit points.
